short_bio: Producer of Top Gun, Pirates of the Caribbean and the CSI franchise.
biography:
Jerry Bruckheimer was born in Detroit and studied psychology at the University of Arizona. He moved from advertising into film and, with Don Simpson, produced Flashdance (1983), Beverly Hills Cop (1984) and Top Gun (1986).

After Simpson’s death in 1996 he continued alone with Con Air, Armageddon (1998) and Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003).

On television his company launched CSI: Crime Scene Investigation in 2000 and produced The Amazing Race, which began in 2001.
